text: agent-bot 是 DeepSeek Harness 的多智能体协作插件，提供团队工具、斜杠命令和 Web 侧栏。用户可创建团队与依赖任务，调度持续运行的子 agent，并查看团队活动和交付评审。团队数据保存在会话工作区的 .agent-teams 目录。适合需要拆解复杂开发或研究任务的 DSH 用户。

agent-bot adds multi-agent teamwork to DeepSeek Harness through tools, a slash command, and a Web sidebar. Create teams and dependent tasks, schedule subagents, track activity, and review deliveries. Team state is stored in the session workspace under .agent-teams.

agent-bot 的功能「团队任务编排」：通过工具创建团队成员和带依赖关系的任务，并由调度器向持续运行的成员分派工作。 通过团队工具或 DSH 界面触发。
agent-bot 的功能「交付验证与评审」：为团队任务设置验收与质量门槛，记录证据并安排评审或修复后续任务。 通过团队工具或 DSH 界面触发。
agent-bot 的功能「团队活动侧栏」：在 DSH 右侧栏展示团队工作区和活动，并可打开队长或成员会话。 通过团队工具或 DSH 界面触发。
agent-bot 的功能「斜杠命令启动」：注册团队命令，可输入目标并选择配置的团队 profile 启动协作。 通过团队工具或 DSH 界面触发。

text:
@eternalnight/agent-bot README · Delivery gates：| Signal | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Full suite | `pnpm verify` exits 0 |
| Browser-side contract | `pnpm verify:web-routes` passes |
| Release artifact | Package smoke test checks runtime and support QR codes, excludes source / tests / docs |
| A real team run | Captain dispatches → members write → independent review → synthesis (covered by the full suite) |
| Isolation | An implementer cannot approve its own implementation |

@eternalnight/agent-bot README · Delivery gates：This is a tool for **parallel wall-clock time plus independent verification**, not a promise that every task gets cheaper; for small tasks a single agent is usually the better deal.

@eternalnight/agent-bot README · Quality gate configuration：| Option | Default | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `autoVerify` | `true` | The host re-runs every declared `verify` command before accepting a finished quality task |
| `autoReview` | `false` | Completes ready review tasks automatically once gates, acceptance and host commands pass |
| `requireAcceptance` | `true` | Automatic review requires every acceptance item of the reviewed task to pass |
| `autoDetect` | `true` | Detects the generated project's own `package.json` test / typecheck scripts and runs them too |
| `reviewMode` | `"auto"` | `auto`: the host closes it; `human`: stops at “awaiting human review” |
| `commands` | `["git diff --check"]` | Fallback verify commands for generated projects |
| `commandsByProject` | `{}` | Verify commands per project root |
| `verifyTimeoutMs` | `120000` | Host timeout per verify command |

@eternalnight/agent-bot README · Quality gate configuration：```yaml quality: autoReview: true reviewMode: "human" # stop at “awaiting human review” after the host passes commandsByProject: ---

ROLES & TEMPLATES

@eternalnight/agent-bot README · Roles and templates：Lineups are picked by “what happens next”; the seat cap is 5, and idle roles spend no tokens. Six task lineups ship today (defined in `src/client/lineup-store.ts`, display names from `src/agency-role-seeds.ts`):

@eternalnight/agent-bot README · Roles and templates：| Lineup | Roles (id → display name) | Good for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Direct delivery** | `product-manager` PM · `engineering-senior-developer` senior developer · `testing-evidence-collector` evidence collector · `engineering-code-reviewer` code reviewer | Fewest detours, straight to the task |
| **Bug fix** | `engineering-codebase-onboarding-engineer` onboarding engineer · `engineering-senior-developer` senior developer · `testing-evidence-collector` evidence collector | Understand the code, then locate and fix |
| **Full-stack feature** | `product-manager` PM · `engineering-frontend-developer` frontend developer · `engineering-backend-architect` backend architect · `testing-evidence-collector` evidence collector · `engineering-code-reviewer` code reviewer | Contract first, front and back in parallel (all 5 seats) |
| **Read-only audit** | `engineering-codebase-onboarding-engineer` onboarding engineer · `engineering-code-reviewer` code reviewer · `testing-evidence-collector` evidence collector · `engineering-technical-writer` technical writer | Touch nothing, only gather evidence |
| **Performance** | `product-manager` PM ·

@eternalnight/agent-bot README · Roles and templates：Six mode presets are generated from development modes as well, plus twelve founding templates: **direct delivery / bug fix / new feature / research / audit / full-stack / hardening / build / refactor / docs / design review / short drama**. Every role gets a fixed contract: ownership, must / must-not, done criteria, a five-point report and a budget. The full-stack lineup keeps all 5 seats on purpose: one less handoff. ---

BOUNDARIES

@eternalnight/agent-bot README · Boundaries：- No hidden cloud sync: growth and feedback diagnostics stay local. - Approval is explicit: a plan draft starts nothing before you approve it. - Deployment needs a clear confirmation: agents never quietly replace a running session. - Review is independent: an implementer cannot approve its own implementation. ---

DEVELOPMENT

@eternalnight/agent-bot README · Development：```powershell pnpm install pnpm typecheck pnpm build pnpm verify After a fresh clone run `pnpm build` before `pnpm verify`: `lib/client/` intermediates and `*.map` files are generated and stay out of git. DSH lifecycle skills are resolved live from the shared memory vault and are not vendored here. ---
